findings.message: Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
Stream 2 is encrypted, so its media objects cannot be analyzed; the stream is described by its header.
The Advanced Content Encryption Object at 0x17E is 34 bytes, too few for its fields; they are read as far as they go.
The file is protected by Windows Media DRM for network devices; the object could not be read in full, so every stream is taken to be encrypted and is reported as the file holds it.
